focus_areas: Legibility and structure of the red pattern/text on the bandage pad (Text Gibberish).
Edge definition between the adhesive tape and the skin (Topology/Boundary).
Realism of skin texture vs. synthetic smoothing.
Confirmation of absent protective strips via object detection.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the red markings on the center of the bandage. Do they form coherent letters/logos or are they nonsensical artifacts? Also, evaluate if the way the bandage wraps around the heel shows realistic tension and adhesion, or if it looks like it's floating or melting into the skin. Verify that no remnants of protective backing paper are visible.
image_description: A close-up view of a human foot, specifically the heel and ankle area, resting on a textured grey surface. A beige adhesive bandage (Band-Aid) is applied to the side of the heel. The bandage features a central pad with visible red markings that resemble text or a pattern but appear illegible. There are faint watermark lines across the image.
